instruction: A megalithic stone circle on a misty moor at night: weathered standing stones with faintly glowing carved runes, a central altar slab, guttering torches on stakes, drifting ground fog, ravens perched on the lintels, a full moon behind clouds, scattered boulders and heather, and a slow pulse of light passing stone to stone.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Ancient Stone Circle. A megalithic stone circle on a misty moor at night: weathered standing stones with faintly glowing carved runes, a central altar slab, guttering torches on stakes, drifting ground fog, ravens perched on the lintels, a full moon behind clouds, scattered boulders and heather, and a slow pulse of light passing stone to stone. Style: mystic megalithic. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
